title: Illegal Removal of Protected Tree
description: Use this service request to report the illegal removal of protected trees from public and/or private property or a protected tree that is endangered by construction. Property owners are responsible for the removal of trees that are not protected. The estimated response time for a request of this nature is 3 business days.

observedQuestions.prompt: Is the lot under 2 acres with a single family/duplex dwelling?
Is the tree on the parkway?
Are they in the process of removing the tree now?
If there is a company sign or contact information on site enter the information here:
Would you like to be contacted?
options: Yes - prior to work being completed
Yes - once the work is completed

detailsForm.branchFinding: All eight combinations of the three required Yes/No answers displayed the same remaining questions and no extra instruction.

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request to report illegal removal of a protected tree on public or private property, or a protected tree endangered by construction.
actions.why: To report illegal removal of a protected tree on public or private property, or a protected tree endangered by construction. The request asks whether the lot is under two acres with a single-family or duplex dwelling, whether the tree is on the parkway, whether removal is happening now, and any company contact information.
actions.why_not: The online form for "Illegal Removal of Protected Tree" requests does not apply to trees that are not protected; property owners are responsible for removing those trees.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Tree Concerns" > Choose "Illegal Removal of Protected Tree"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "Tree Concerns" > Choose "Illegal Removal of Protected Tree"
